body.interpretation: Read the 64-bit field at [param_2 + 0x20]; if non-zero add 1 (i.e. field = field + (field != 0), so a non-zero-guarded increment: 0 stays 0, n!=0 becomes n+1); write it back. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xcb8 (index 407). No other side effects, no return value.

pattern_note: Identical shape to every other AFortCreativeMoveTool input handler (e.g. HandleDeletePressed 0x1428c2bc0 -> vtable 0xc80, HandleExitReleased 0x1428c2cc0 -> vtable 0xcc0, HandleExitHeldDownLongEnough 0x1428c2c80 -> vtable 0xcc8). All are a non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of [param_2+0x20] followed by a tail jump to a class vtable slot. The vtable slot holds the real handler body; the reflected exec entry is only the counter side-effect plus the dispatch.
unresolved_contracts: Virtual function identity at AFortCreativeMoveTool vtable byte offset 0xcb8 (index 407) - the real Exit-pressed handler body - is not identified.
